info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v1-spec
info.description: The Withdraw Career Application API allows users to withdraw their submitted career applications efficiently. This endpoint is crucial for candidates who wish to retract their applications in a timely manner, ensuring they can manage their job search actively. Typically utilized by job applicants who want to withdraw an application after submission, this operation helps maintain user data accuracy and aligns with candidates' changing preferences. By providing this functionality, organizations can enhance their application management processes.

delete.description: This operation allows the user to withdraw their application. It effectively cancels the submitted application and updates the application status accordingly.

requestBody.description: Request body for withdrawing an application. This contains the necessary parameters to process the withdrawal request.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting an application withdrawal.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.title: Application Withdrawal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the withdrawal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: The current state of the application after the withdrawal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the withdrawal request in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message regarding the result of the withdrawal operation.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the application withdrawal operation indicating the result of the deletion request.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was triggered automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details regarding the audit log of the withdrawal operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates the processing was instantaneous.
